shapeSummary: Simplified extended micro linear actuator, 157 mm long along X (X from -78.5 to 78.5), 21 mm tall in Y (bottom at Y=0), 16 mm wide in Z. A rectangular rear case (48 x 21 x 16) sits at +X. A 12 x 12 mm square extension tube runs forward from the case. A 14 x 14 x 12 mm front end block and a cylindrical shaft stub (diameter 8) form the front end at -X. One 4.25 mm through hole along Z near the rear end, 4.25 mm from the end face.
warnings: Case, tube and cap cross-sections and lengths are estimated from the photo, not from stated dimensions.
The rear mounting ear is merged into the rectangular case block instead of being modeled as a separate narrower tab.
The second 4.25 mm hole from the analysis (x=-19.6) was omitted. It is not visible in the photo and would fall in the middle of the extension tube.
The hole in the front shaft-end fitting is visible but has no stated size, so it was omitted.
The 300 mm cable is not modeled.
Hole axis direction (Z) is ambiguous in the source analysis.
The tube and shaft are centered vertically on the case, which is an assumption.
cadquery:
case = cq.Workplane('XY').box(48, 21, 16).translate((54.5, 10.5, 0))
tube = cq.Workplane('XY').box(97, 12, 12).translate((-17.5, 10.5, 0))
cap = cq.Workplane('XY').box(12, 14, 14).translate((-66, 10.5, 0))
shaft = cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-78.5).center(10.5, 0).circle(4).extrude(6.5)
part = case.union(tube).union(cap).union(shaft)
hole = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-10).center(74.25, 10.5).circle(2.125).extrude(20)
part = part.cut(hole)
